2. Petitioner has been made accused in connection with Angara P.S. Case No. 52 of 2023 for the offences registered under sections 406, 420, 467, 468, 471 and 120B/34 of the Indian Penal Code,
pending in the court of Smt. Ila Kandpal, learned Judicial Magistrate, 1st Class, Ranchi.
3.
It is alleged that the petitioner had helped the Informant and her husband in disposing of their land for more than one crore rupees.
Petitioner got a joint bank account opened in the name of the Informant and her husband.
He also got a mobile number attached with the said account which belonged to the witness Kalawati Devi.
Petitioner also enticed the husband of the Informant to handover several signed blank cheques, so that which he could get the money transferred in another bank account.
After the death of the husband of the Informant, when the Informant inquired about the status of her bank account, she came to know that entire money was withdrawn.
During the course of investigation, Kalawati Devi whose mobile phone was attached with the said account of the Informant has stated that it was the petitioner who was using her mobile phone.
Some of the witnesses have also stated that the petitioner has cheated several persons.
